```yaml
name: Auto-Merge Release Branch
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'jdx/mise' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Setup Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "mise-en-dev"
          git config user.email "mise-en-dev@users.noreply.github.com"
      
      - name: Check for open release PR
        id: check_pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --state open --base main --head release --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "No open PR found from release to main"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Found PR: $PR_NUMBER"
      
      - name: Auto-merge PR
        if: ${{ steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number != '' }}
        run: |
          gh pr merge --merge --auto ${{ steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number }} || true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
```
